description: Morphos AI is an applied AI research company building the information architecture that makes capable AI practical beyond the data center. AI models are becoming small enough to run almost anywhere. The information…
long_description: Morphos AI is an applied AI research company building the information architecture that makes capable AI practical beyond the data center. AI models are becoming small enough to run almost anywhere. The information they depend on is not. Our patent-pending Green VectorsTM technology organizes related information, consolidates what overlaps, preserves context, and updates what is already known, so AI systems have less to store, carry, and search. The result is a compact, current information layer that makes room for more useful knowledge within fixed memory, compute, power, and connectivity. For language systems, Green Vectors works alongside existing embedding models, vector databases, and retrieval tools rather than requiring organizations to replace them. In a benchmark using approximately 50,000 public-domain books from Project Gutenberg, Green Vectors reduced the stored vector-index size from 260GB to 1.3GB under defined conditions. Our Language Intelligence technology has measured results, and Kitana, our SDK and API, is in scoped beta. We are also developing applications for perception, sensor data, telemetry, and autonomous systems. Capable AI should not be confined to data centers. Morphos is building the foundation for it to operate wherever it is needed—from enterprise infrastructure to vehicles, robots, satellites, and the edge.
